reviewer.role: Independent QA agent (deterministic recomputation plus direct visual inspection)
reviewer.method: Raw PNG pixels (pngjs) and SHA-256 hashes recomputed from sources; pilot scripts not reused for evidence; visual review of representative 2x sheet, 10x grip zoom and F06 full frames in both variants.
reviewer.independenceNote: No paid PixelLab calls; no Unity writes; review limited to experiments/main-orc-hybrid-weapon-04b2 and its consumed source.

freezeDefinition: SHA-256 over ordered (relativePath, fileSha256) pairs of: full/a/composite.aseprite, full/b/composite.aseprite, variants/sword-{a,b}/sword.png, variants/sword-{a,b}/sword.aseprite, verification.json, report.md, blade-repaint-stats.json, grip-pivot-fit.json, grip-profile-back-r.json, edge-diagnostics.json, weapon-diff.json, pixel-diff.json, representative-review-2x.png, grip-10x-both.png, review/index.html.

satisfactory: F06 dual-depth split (hilt in front of body 51px, leather grip behind) correct in both variants
1px dark outline continuous, no black-rim thickening, no matte halo around pale blade B
Blade B silhouette overlays blade A pixel-for-pixel
Grip anchor visually coincides with fist fit in both variants
Zero weapon pixels in unarmed frames (attack-only-v1 respected)
deferredToCreator: Material contrast of the pale faceted steel blade against the darker rear body (aesthetic decision)

Disposition on inherited V8 rear-body characteristics documented in report.md section 7 (body luma F02..F11, F02->F03 pose jump, F07..F09 forearm foreshortening) - none introduced or worsened by this composition

nonBlockingObservations.observation: declaredValidWeaponPixels drops 20-39 px below total weapon pixel count and color SAD rises on high-rotation frames. Attributed to rotation-render rounding seams (1-2 px), identical in variants A and B (consequence of silhouetteDeltaAB = 0) and inherited from the recovery. Not a composition defect; no action required.

invalidationRule: Verdict valid only for the exact freezeId above; any modification under experiments/main-orc-hybrid-weapon-04b2 requires a new independent QA review.
